prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Path selection hints (choose_path, hint) were helpful, winning in both tests.
Home wait_info changes (3 tests), sign-in reordering (2 tests), and finish notification changes (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Adoption stage redesigns (3 tests) and path selection layout changes (2 tests) did not improve conversion, with larger redesigns hurting performance.
Evidence is still thin for single-test categories including adoption/new_screen, choose_path/copy, choose_path/redesign, finish/copy, finish/hint, finish/layout, finish/redesign, home/hint, home/notification, home/redesign, sign_in/copy, sign_in/hint, and sign_in/redesign.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, copy] Instant Desktop Play Path Selection Copy: Update path selection copy to clearly state both paths immediately create an active companion on your screen. (why: Mean time spent on path selection is 514s, indicating indecision around what each adoption option does.)
1: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout for Custom Photo Stage: Switch upload_photos layout to stage view with clear progress counter. (why: Custom pet adoption has a 39.1% drop-off rate and 3 support users reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Initialization Progress Checklist: Add system initialization checklist items and visual step progress to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step drops 18.7% with a mean time of 2336s; 3 support tickets reported app stalling or pet failing to display.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Completion Audio Notification Alert: Enable optional audio notification alert when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s (38 minutes), leading users to move away from their computer and forget about completion.)
4: [finish, hint] System Tray Controls Guidance Hint: Add a prominent hint explaining how to find, control, and show/hide the pet using the desktop system tray icon. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion over how to control/hide/talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)

scores.note: Choose_path has low drop-off (16.2%). Copy change evidence comes only from funnel duration without support complaints, and prior choose_path copy test resulted in -1.0%.
Adoption drops 39.1% with strong support email alignment. However, redesigns and layout changes at adoption consistently hurt performance (-2.2%) and require new UI screens.
Home wait time is extreme (2336s) with direct support complaints. However, home wait_info was tested 3 times and showed no clear positive effect (-0.7%).
Low implementation cost feature targeting home wait drop-off, but lack of support mail evidence and past home notification test result (-0.8%) indicate minimal impact.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users with clear support complaints. Hints generally perform better than redesigns, though the single finish hint test yielded -1.3%.
